name: get_disputes
description: Returns a list of your disputes. (GET /v1/disputes)

charge.description: Only return disputes associated to the charge specified by this charge ID.

payment_intent.description: Only return disputes associated to the PaymentIntent specified by this PaymentIntent ID.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 30.
